supporting_observations.claim: At 13:44:52 UTC, WS-JFROST-01 made a successful proxied GET for https://raw.githubusercontent.com/maplehill-it/tools/main/u.ps1, with user MAPLEHILL\julia.frost and user agent "-".
A subsequent connection to raw.githubusercontent.com at 13:44:53 UTC had no proxy user and was denied with status 407.

Shortly before the reported PowerShell window, WS-JFROST-01 connected to DC-MAP-01 over SMB; the DC recorded a network logon for the workstation computer account. This differs from the documented patching workflow, but the records do not establish what was accessed or why.

The GitHub script request and nearby SMB activity are suspicious in the context of the alert, but the available records do not link either action to a PowerShell process or establish that the script was executed.

known_telemetry_limitations: Winsec and Sysmon collection for WS-JFROST-01 was unavailable from 13:30 through 14:15 UTC due to a log collection outage. This covers the reported alert time and the GitHub script request.
Proxy, Zeek connection, and Zeek DNS sensors were reported operational, but those records do not show process creation, PowerShell command lines, or script contents.
claims_not_established: Whether Julia Frost or another person launched the reported PowerShell window.
Whether PowerShell downloaded or executed u.ps1, what the script contains, or whether it caused any changes.
Whether the SMB connection to DC-MAP-01 or the GitHub request was authorized or related to the reported window.
Whether the activity resulted in compromise, persistence, credential access, or data loss.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover any buffered or locally retained Sysmon, Security, PowerShell Operational, and PowerShell script-block logs for WS-JFROST-01 during 13:30–14:15 UTC.
Collect endpoint forensic evidence for PowerShell history, console/process artifacts, browser or download caches, and the contents and provenance of u.ps1.
Verify whether maplehill-it/tools and the specific u.ps1 path are organization-controlled and approved, and ask Julia Frost whether she initiated the request or recognized the window.
Review the SMB session details and any corresponding file-server, domain-controller, and endpoint records to determine what resource was accessed and whether it aligns with approved administration.
unrelated_findings: WS-JFROST-01 accessed Google Drive pages at 13:45:35–13:45:55 UTC; Google Drive is not among the approved services listed in the inventory. Handle separately; this does not establish the cause of the reported PowerShell window. (T143-00229, T143-00230, T143-00245, T143-00251, T143-00256)
